Todas las métricas que calcula WFM Rescu: Every metric WFM Rescue calculates is documented here: definition, formula, unit, source fields, assumptions and limitations. No black boxes.
Las fórmulas documentadas aquí son las q: The formulas documented here are the ones the product's calculation engine actually uses. If you detect a deviation from your ACD or WFM convention, please report it.
Porcentaje de contactos atendidos dentro: Percentage of contacts answered within the agreed time threshold (e.g. 80% in 20 seconds).
Los abandonos antes del umbral se excluy: Abandons before the threshold are excluded from the denominator by default (common industry practice).
La agregación diaria no es un promedio s: Daily aggregation is not a simple average; it is recalculated from totals when they are available.
Erlang-C asume cero abandonos; el SL rea: Erlang-C assumes zero abandons; actual SL may differ from modeled SL.
Tiempo promedio total por contacto: conv: Average total handle time per contact: talk + hold + after-call work (ACW). Used to calculate workload and requirement.
Precisión del pronóstico por volumen usa: Volume forecast accuracy using WAPE (Weighted Absolute Percentage Error). Better than MAPE because it does not inflate errors from small intervals.
Porcentaje del tiempo registrado (loggea: Percentage of logged-in time that an agent is actually busy handling contacts or in after-call work.
Dotación necesaria para alcanzar el obje: Staffing needed to reach the SL target. Calculated with Erlang-C + configured shrinkage.
Se añade shrinkage para convertir 'bodie: Shrinkage is added to convert 'bodies in chairs' into agents required in the schedule.
Bajo-dimensiona cuando hay abandono sign: Under-sizes when there is significant abandonment or non-Poisson arrivals (chat with backlog).
Porcentaje del tiempo que el agente está: Percentage of time the agent is in the correct activity according to their schedule. Distinguish from 'conformance' (total worked vs total scheduled)
Adherence mide 'en la actividad correcta: Adherence measures 'in the right activity at the right time'; Conformance measures the total at the end of the day.
Porcentaje del tiempo pagado que los age: Percentage of paid time in which agents are NOT handling contacts (breaks, training, meetings, coaching, absences, unproductive AUX, etc.).
Proporción del tiempo logueado en código: Share of logged-in time spent in unproductive AUX codes.
Las métricas se añaden según la demanda: Metrics are added based on customer demand. If you need a metric specific to your operation (e.g. SLA per skill with specific thresholds), contact us.
Vista consolidada del día. Todos los KPI: Consolidated daily view. All KPIs are calculated with the documented formulas and respond to the filters.
Agregado por cola para todos los filtros: Aggregated by queue for all active filters
Monitoreo intervalo a intervalo. Se prio: Interval-by-interval monitoring. Intervals with the greatest operational impact are prioritized, not just those with the worst SL.
Análisis de dotación: requerido vs progr: Staffing analysis: required vs scheduled vs present. Identifies gaps by interval and queue with financial impact.
Análisis de adherencia al schedule (mome: Schedule adherence analysis (right time, right activity), conformance (total hours), and the AUX codes with the greatest impact.
Adherence mide conformidad con la activi: Adherence measures conformity with the scheduled activity in each interval; conformance measures total hours worked. An agent can have 100% conformance and lower adherence.
Barras con gradiente, rojo si excede: Gradient bars, red if over the limit
Planificación de capacidad y FTE. Convie: Capacity and FTE planning. Converts volume and AHT into staffing requirements with and without shrinkage.
